description: This Java source file defines the abstract class FlexibleStringExpander, which is responsible for parsing, caching, and expanding expressions embedded within strings, supporting nested expressions, script execution (e.g., Groovy), currency formatting, and expression evaluation in a given context. It is part of the OFBiz framework, specifically within the package org.apache.ofbiz.base.util.string.

classes.name: FlexibleStringExpander
classes.description: Abstract class for handling string expressions with embedded EL syntax, supporting caching, nested expressions, scripts, currency formatting, and evaluation within context objects.

classes.name: ConstSimpleElem
classes.description: Represents a string constant segment of an expression.

classes.name: ConstOffsetElem
classes.description: Represents a string segment with specified offset and length, typically constant.

classes.name: CurrElem
classes.description: Represents a currency formatted expression element.

classes.name: Elements
classes.description: Represents a collection of nested expression elements, which are evaluated and concatenated.

classes.name: ScriptElem
classes.description: Represents an embedded script (e.g., Groovy) expression that can be evaluated.

classes.name: NestedVarElem
classes.description: Represents a nested variable expression that may contain nested expressions within.

methods.name: containsConstant
methods.description: Checks if the FlexibleStringExpander contains a string constant part.

methods.name: containsExpression
methods.description: Checks if it contains an expression.

methods.name: containsScript
methods.description: Checks if it contains a script expression.

methods.name: expandString
methods.description: Evaluates an expression string within a given context and optional locale/time zone, returning the expanded string.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached instance of FlexibleStringExpander for a given expression string.
